metadata.description: A personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: kpj
plugins.description: A personal collection of skills and agents for PR workflows (address-pr-comments, pair-review-pr, update-pr-description, self-review), stacked PRs (manage-stacked-pr), Memory Bank projects (initialize/resume-memory-bank-project), execution plans (create-plan, resume-plan, validate-docs), ADRs (draft-adr), design docs (draft-design-doc), and skill authoring (build-skill). Skills invoke under the `kpj:` namespace.
